description: This file defines the ImportServiceDelegate class, which acts as a delegate for importing books from external services such as LibraryThing and Goodreads within the book project. It uses dependency injection to reference these services and provides methods to trigger book import operations.

classes.name: ImportServiceDelegate
classes.description: A service class that delegates the import operations for books from LibraryThing and Goodreads platforms.

methods.name: importFromLibraryThing
methods.description: Imports books from LibraryThing using provided import data.

methods.name: importFromGoodreads
methods.description: Initiates the import of books from Goodreads; currently a placeholder for passing data from an endpoint.
